text:
Situation: Bacteriostatic water has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-12-03 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 59 months. Current inventory shows Corvale East has 40 vials (11.3 days on hand) and Corvale General has 83 vials (19.5 days on hand) of the 30 mL presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the product has been continuously listed on the drug shortage list since 2021-12-03. FDA inspection 1106244 at the Pfizer Healthcare India plant (FEI 3008316085) ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2020-03-25. The Hospira, Inc. plant (FEI 1925262) received an OAI classification letter dated 2020-04-22, and another OAI inspection (1064827) ended 2018-08-15 with classification letter 2020-04-22.

Our position: Supply is critically low at both campuses. The rule‑ranked alternate manufacturer Fujian Genohope Biotech Ltd. is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place. Two additional suppliers (HF Acquisition Co LLC and ProPharma Distribution) are also not on the shortage list but lack identifiable plant information. An alternate concentration from Nephron Pharmaceuticals Corporation was approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-07-09.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Fujian Genohope Biotech Ltd. for emergency purchase; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate and qualify HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst for emergency purchase; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate and qualify ProPharma Distribution for emergency purchase; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Pharmacist to verify and implement Sterile Water 1 mL/mL from Nephron Pharmaceuticals Corporation per prior approval by Riley Brooks, PharmD; requires P&T Committee ratification.

Not recommended: No action that assumes supply will normalize without procurement changes.
